fusions.name: Barbed Parting
fusions.desc: Tears 4 barbed hairs from your scalp at a cost of 4% of your maximum health and looses them spread apart, each dealing 6 poison damage. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Scent
fusions.desc: Flicks a scent-tipped strand at a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Beard of Stingers
fusions.desc: A swarm settles in your hair as a living beard and fights from it for 15 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Combed Nectar
fusions.desc: Every hit you land dusts your hair with pollen: a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
